children.content: The DOCX format uses Uniword to parse OOXML into a typed model tree, then transforms to CoreModel:
lines: The DOCX format uses Uniword to parse OOXML into a typed model tree, then transforms to CoreModel:

children.content:
DOCX file
  → Uniword::DocumentFactory.from_file
  → OOXML model tree (Uniword::Wordprocessingml::*)
  → Ceradoc::Docx::Transform::ToCoreModel
  → CoreModel tree (canonical hub)
  → FromCoreModel (AsciiDoc or Markdown)
  → Format model tree → Serializer → .adoc or .md file

children.text: - DOCX → CoreModel is supported; CoreModel → DOCX is not yet implemented

items.content: Parse only - DOCX → CoreModel is supported; CoreModel → DOCX is not yet implemented

children.text: - Page size, margins, headers/footers as page regions are discarded (CoreModel is semantic, not print layout)

items.content: Print layout - Page size, margins, headers/footers as page regions are discarded (CoreModel is semantic, not print layout)

children.text: - Field characters (TOC, PAGE) are partially handled

items.content: Complex fields - Field characters (TOC, PAGE) are partially handled
Tracked changes - Deleted text is currently skipped
VML shapes - Only inline drawings are extracted

children.text: - Nested include directives may not resolve correctly

items.content: Complex includes - Nested include directives may not resolve correctly
Custom macros - User-defined macros require custom handlers
Backend-specific features - PDF/DocBook backends not supported
Counter variables - Limited counter variable support

children.text: - Syntax differs from some Markdown flavors

items.content: Definition lists - Syntax differs from some Markdown flavors
Math blocks - LaTeX math not natively supported

children.text: - No equivalent to AsciiDoc open blocks

items.content: Custom containers - No equivalent to AsciiDoc open blocks
Script tags - JavaScript content is stripped
Style tags - CSS content is stripped
Custom elements - Web components not supported
